scope: Kino reconstruction, including v1.7 native weapon alias recovery and zombie impact effects
sourcePolicy: Native means the recording is backed by an original source archive path and SHA256 in the manifest. Hook timing, reconstructed surface selection, attenuation and mix are separately described. Synthesized substitutes are explicit.

spatialPolicy.listener: camera position/forward/up, updated during active simulation
spatialPolicy.oneShotEmitters: Position is copied at request time and does not move during playback.
spatialPolicy.movingCreatureEmitters: Emitter position follows each active actor at 10Hz. Geometry obstruction is checked at most 5Hz per active voice, plus its initial request.

creatureOcclusion.method: world.lineClear camera-to-emitter visibility callback; reconstructed approximation, not recovered T5 room acoustics
creatureOcclusion.scope: Creature vocals, creature footsteps and their barrier tear effects only; other effects retain their existing mix.

lifecycle.pause: Suspend AudioContext; retain existing voices for resume.
lifecycle.reset: Invalidate pending decodes and pending vocal replacements, stop sources including retiring voices, disconnect all gain/filter/panner nodes, clear recent-event history.
lifecycle.bufferBudget: Existing desktop/mobile decoded-byte budget retained; shared cues decode on demand. Trap synthesis caches at most two two-second mono buffers (16 * sampleRate bytes total), exposed as syntheticBufferBytes.

V1.4 moving creature voices are smoothly low-pass filtered and attenuated when world geometry obstructs the listener-to-emitter segment; this is an authored audibility approximation, not exact original room acoustics.

V1.5 seeded selection and restrained per-actor pitch/level are authored adaptations using the same credited recordings. Pursuit/spawn gain is reduced relative to attack and death; no room reverb, generated creature sounds or new samples are introduced.

variation.selection: Per-run seeded shuffle bags select every recording in an event family before repeating; no immediate repeat at a bag boundary; independent of gameplay random state. A later lifecycle cancellation may prevent a selected request from playing.
variation.identity: Seed and actor ID select a stable pitch multiplier in [0.965,1.035] and volume multiplier in [0.92,1]. Existing Nova pitch adaptation remains the base.
variation.leveling: Measured decoded RMS attenuates vocal samples above 0.30 for attack/death or 0.26 for other calls. Never boosts, edits, or regenerates source recordings.
variation.envelope: 6ms onset and 12ms natural ending taper; priority interruption uses a bounded 18ms release. Reset/removal still stop and disconnect immediately.
